Enjoy your favorite plaza game even more with MölkkyApp!

A scoreboard app specialized for Mölkky.
It is easy to use with simple operations. You can also change team names and set the order in which to throw the mölkky.

You can play as many sets of matches as you want, so whether you want to play a little or a lot, you can have fun.

● Scoring Method
Tap the number of the fallen skittles. If there are multiple skittles, tap more than one. When you press the “Scoring” button, the app will automatically calculate the score and add the points. If you made a mistake in the score, you can go back to the previous state by tapping the “Undo” button.

● Fouls
If you foul three times in a row, you will be disqualified and your score will be calculated as zero.

● If the score exceeds 50 points
If the score exceeds 50 points, the score is automatically reduced to 25 points.
